Luganda: Kookolo w’omu baana mu bukiikaddyo bwa Ethiopia 1963 – 1986
Yoruba: Ààrùn jẹjẹrẹ ìgbà ọmọdé ní ọdún 1963-1986 ní apá-gúúsù Ethiopia
Hausa: Ciwon daji na yara a kudancin Habasha 1963 - 1986
Northern Sotho: Dikankere go mengwaga ya bosweng ka borwa bja Ethiopia 1963 – 1986

English: The pattern of childhood malignancies from southern Ethiopia is presented as it appears from a retrospective study of biopsy proven malignancies during the period 1963—1986.
Luganda: Ebikwata ku kookolo w’omu baana mu bukiikaddyo bwa Ethiopia biragiddwa nga bwe byazuulibwa mu kunoonyereza kw’okukebera obunyama okukakasa kookolo mu kiseera 1963—1986.
Yoruba: Àpẹẹrẹ ààrùn burúkú àwon ọmọdé láti apá gúúsù Ethiopia ni wọ́n gbé jáde gẹ́gẹ́ bí ó ṣe farahàn nínú ìwádìí tí wọ́n ṣe kọjá lórí ìmújáde fún àyẹ̀wò to ṣàfihàn ààrùn burúkú ni ọdun 1963-1986.
Zulu: Iphethini yezifo ezilimazayo zezingane ezivela eningizimu ye-Ethiopia zethulwa njengoba zivela ocwaningweni olwenziwa kabusha lwezifo ezifakazelwe ze-biopsy phakathi nenkathi ka-1963-1986.
Hausa: An gabatar da tsarin haɓakar kansar yara daga kudancin Habasha kamar yadda ya bayyana daga wani bincike na baya-bayan nan game da cututtukan da aka tabbatar da ƙwayoyin halitta na haɓakar kansar a lokacin shekarar 1963 zuwa shekarar 1986.
Northern Sotho: Sebopego sa malwetši a kotsi ya bosweng go tšwa ka borwa bja Ethiopia se hlagišitšwe bjalo ka ge e tšwelela go tšwa go dinyakišišo tša go bušetšwa morago tša payopsi ya malwetši a kotsi ao a hlatsetšwego nakong ya mengwaga ya 1963—1986.
Amharic: በ1963-1986 ባለው ጊዜ ውስጥ ባዮፕሲ የተረጋገጡ የካንሰር እድገት ወደ ኋላ መለስ ብሎ በማጥናት በደቡብ ኢትዮጵያ የሚታየው የልጅነት የካንሰር እድገት አይነት ቀርቧል።

English: Retinoblastoma was the most frequently observed tumour, but lymphomas were also frequently observed.
Luganda: Retinoblastoma kye kizimba ekyasinga okusangibwa, naye ne lymphomas nabyo byasangibwa nnyo.
Yoruba: Kókó ọlọ́yún tí wọ́n ṣàkíyèsi pé ó máa ń jẹyọ jù ni ààrùn jẹjẹrẹ ojú, ṣùgbọ́n wọ́n sàkíyèsi ìjẹyọ ààrùn jẹjẹrẹ omi-ara lemọ́lemọ́.
Zulu: I-Retinoblastoma yayiyi-tumor evame ukubonwa, kodwa i-lymphomas nayo yayibhekwa njalo.
Hausa: Kansar ƙwayar ido ita ce ƙwayar cuta da aka fi gani akai-akai, amma ana kuma lura da kansar garkuwar jiki akai-akai.
Northern Sotho: Retinoblastoma e bile sekutu se se lemogilwego kgafetšakgafetša, eupša dilimfoma le tšona di lemogilwe kgafetšakgafetša.
Amharic: ሬቲኖብላስቶማ በጣም በተደጋጋሚ የሚታይ ዕጢ ነው፣ ነገር ግን ሊምፎማዎች በተደጋጋሚ ተስተውለዋል።

English: Hodgkin's Disease and Burkitt's lymphoma were the two most common lymphoma types.
Luganda: Kookolo wa Hodgkin's ne Burkitt's lymphoma bye bika bya lymphoma ebibiri ebyasinga okulabwa.
Yoruba: Ààrùn jẹjẹrẹ iṣan-ara Hodgkin àti Burkitt ni ó gbajúgbà jù láàárín irúfẹ́ ààrùn jẹjẹrẹ ìṣan-ara.
Zulu: I-Hodgkin's Disease kanye ne-Burkitt's lymphoma kwakuyizinhlobo ezimbili ezivame kakhulu ze-lymphoma.
Hausa: Cutar Hodgkin da kansar garkuwar jiki ta Burkitt su ne nau’o’in kansar garkuwar jiki na yau da kullum.
Northern Sotho: Kankere ya go hlasela mašole a mmele le kankere ya go se hlasele mašole a mmele e bile mehuta ye mebedi ya dilimfoma yeo e tlwaelegilego kudu.
Amharic: የሆጅኪን በሽታ እና የቡርኪት ሊምፎማ ሁለቱ በጣም የተለመዱ የሊምፎማ ዓይነቶች ነበሩ።

English: Childhood cancer patterns in Ethiopia from 1963 to 1986
Luganda: Ebikwata ku kookolo w’omu baana mu Ethiopia okuva mu 1963 okutuuka mu 1986
Yoruba: Àpẹẹrẹ ààrùn jẹjẹrẹ lára àwọn ọmọde ní Ethiopianláti 1963 dé 1986
Zulu: Amaphethini omdlavuza wezingane e-Ethiopia kusukela ngo-1963 kuya ku-1986
Hausa: Halin ciwon daji na yara a Habasha daga shekarar 1963 zuwa shekarar 1986
Northern Sotho: Dibopego tša kankere ya bosweng go la Ethiopia go tloga ka 1963 go fihla ka 1986
Amharic: የልጅነት ካንሰር ሁኔታዎች በኢትዮጵያ ከ1963 እስከ 1986

English: A study found that between 1963 and 1986, cancer of the eye, known as retinoblastoma, was most common in Ethiopian children aged 0-14 years, followed by cancers of the immune system (lymphomas).
Luganda: Okunoonyereza kwakizuula nti wakati wa 1963 ne 1986, kookolo w’amaaso, amanyiddwa nga retinoblastoma, yalabibwa nnyo mu baana b’omu Ethiopia ab’emyaka 0-14, n’addirirwa kookolo w’obusibage (lymphomas).
Yoruba: Ìwádìí fihàn pé láàárín 1963 àti 1986, ààrùn jẹjẹrẹ ojú, tí wọ́n mọ ni ààrùn- jẹjẹrẹ-oju jẹ́ ààrùn tí ó wọ́pọ̀ jù láàárín àwọn ọmọdé tí ọjọ́ orí wọn kò ju ọmọ ọdún 0-14 lọ ní Ethiopia, jẹjẹrẹ àjẹsára (ààrùn jẹjẹrẹ omi-ara) ni ó tẹ̀ lé e.
Zulu: Ucwaningo luthole ukuthi phakathi kuka-1963 no-1986, umdlavuza weso, owaziwa nge-retinoblastoma, wawuvame kakhulu ezinganeni zase-Ethiopia ezineminyaka engu-0-14 ubudala, ulandelwa umdlavuza wesimiso sokuzivikela komzimba (ama-lymphomas).
Hausa: Wani bincike ya gano cewa a tsakanin shekarar 1963 zuwa shekarar 1986, ciwon daji na ido, wanda aka sani da kansar ƙwayar ido, ita ce gama gari a cikin yaran Habasha masu shekaru 0 zuwa 14, sannan kuma ciwon daji na tsarin garkuwar jiki (kansar garkuwar jiki) .
Northern Sotho: Dinyakišišo di utollotše gore magareng ga 1963 le 1986, kankere ya leihlo, ye e tsebegago bjalo ka retinoblastoma, e be e tumile kudu go bana ba Ethiopia ba mengwaga ye 0-14, ya latelwa ke dikankere tša mašole a mmele (dilimfoma).
Amharic: በ1963 እና 1986 ባለው ጊዜ ውስጥ፣ ሬቲኖብላስቶማ በመባል የሚታወቀው፣ የዓይን ካንሰር ከ0-14 አመት እድሜ ክልል ውስጥ ባሉ ኢትዮጵያውያን ልጆች ላይ በብዛት ይከሰት እንደነበር አንድ ጥናት አረጋግጧል፣ ከዚህም በኋላ የበሽታ መከላከል ስርአት ካንሰሮች (ሊምፎማዎች)።

English: Monitoring cancer rates in different parts of the world makes it easier to understand the causes and burdens of various cancer types.
Luganda: Okulondoola emiwendo gya kookolo mu bitundu by’ensi eby’enjawulo kyanguya okutegeera ebireeta ebika bya kookolo eby’enjawulo n’obulabe bw’aleeta.
Yoruba: Ṣíṣe àbójútó ìwọ̀n ààrùn jẹjẹrẹ ní oríṣiríṣi apá kọ̀ọ̀kan ní àgbáyé jẹ́ kí ó rọrùn láti ní òye okùnfà àti ẹrù oríṣiríṣi ààrùn jẹjẹrẹ.
Zulu: Ukuqapha amazinga omdlavuza ezingxenyeni ezahlukene zomhlaba kwenza kube lula ukuqonda izimbangela nemithwalo yezinhlobo ezahlukene zomdlavuza.
Hausa: Kula da ciwon daji a sassa daban-daban na duniya yana sauƙaƙa fahimtar musabbabai da nauyin nau’o’in ciwon daji daban-daban.
Northern Sotho: Go lekodišiša dikelo tša kankere go dikarolo tša go fapafapana tša lefase go nolofatša gabonolo go kwešiša tšeo di bakago mehuta ya go fapafapana ya dikankere le mathata a gona.
Amharic: በተለያዩ የአለም ክፍሎች የካንሰር ምጣኔን መከታተል የተለያዩ የካንሰር አይነቶች መንስኤዎችን እና ሸክሞችን በቀላሉ ለመረዳት ያስችላል።

English: Childhood cancer in Ethiopia is not well understood, however, and so the author wanted to look at the pattern of childhood cancers in this country to find out which cancer types are the most common.
Luganda: Wabula, kookolo w’omu baana mu Ethiopia tategeerwa bulungi, noolwekyo omunoonyereza yayagala okutunuulira enneeyisa ya kookolo mu baana mu ggwanga lino okusobola okuzuula bika ki ebya kookolo ebisinga okusangika.
Yoruba: Kò sí òye kíkún nípa àrùn jẹjẹrẹ láàárín àwọn ọmọdé, àmọ́, akọ̀wé fẹ́ wo àpẹẹre àwọn ààrùn jẹjẹrẹ láàárín àwọn ọmọdé ní orílẹ̀-èdè yìí láti mọ̀ irúfẹ́ èyí tí ó wọ́pọ̀ jù lọ.
Zulu: [A-Z] mdlavuza wezingane e-Ethiopia awuqondi kahle, nokho, ngakho umbhali wayefuna ukubheka iphethini yomdlavuza wezingane kuleli zwe ukuze uthole ukuthi yiziphi izinhlobo zomdlavuza ezivame kakhulu. evamile.
Hausa: Ba a fahimci cutar sankarar yara a Habasha sosai ba, domin haka, marubucin ya so ya duba yanayin ciwon daji na yara a wannan ƙasa domin gano nau’o’in ciwon daji ne suka fi zama gama gari.
Northern Sotho: Kankere ya bana bosweng go la Ethiopia ga e kwešišwe gabotse, le ge go le bjalo, le gona mongwadi o be a nyaka go lebelela pattern ya dikankere tša bana bosweng ka nageng ye go utolla gore ke mehuta efe ya dikankere yeo e tumilego kudu.
Amharic: በኢትዮጵያ ውስጥ ያለው የልጅነት ካንሰር ግን በደንብ አልተረዳም፣ ስለዚህ ፀሐፊው በዚህች ሀገር የልጅነት ካንሰሮች ሁኔታን ለመመልከት የፈለገው የትኞቹ የካንሰር ዓይነቶች በብዛት እንደሚገኙ ለማወቅ ነው።

English: The researcher studied cancer reports of patients aged 0-14 years from 3 different hospitals during the period 1963 to 1986.
Luganda: Omunoonyereza yeetegereza alipoota ezikwata ku kookolo mu balwadde ab’emyaka 0-14 okuva mu malwaliro ag’enjawulo 3 mu kitundu 1963 ku 1986.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí ṣe àgbéyẹ̀wò èsì àwọn aláìsà ààrùn jẹjẹrẹ tí ọjọ́ orí wọn jẹ́ ọmọ ọdun 0-14 láti ilẹ́-ìwòsàn 3 ọ̀tọ̀ọ̀tọ̀ ní ọdun 1963 sí 1986.
Zulu: Umcwaningi wacwaninga imibiko yomdlavuza yeziguli ezineminyaka engu-0-14 kusukela ezibhedlela ezi-3 ezahlukene phakathi nesikhathi sika-1963 kuya ku-1986.
Hausa: Mai binciken ya yi nazari a kan rahotannin ciwon daji na marasa lafiya masu shekaru 0 zuwa 14 daga asibitoci daban-daban guda 3 a tsakanin shekarun 1963 zuwa 1986.
Northern Sotho: Monyakišiši o lekodišitše dipego tša kankere tša balwetši ba mengwaga ye 0-14 go tšwa dipetleleng tše di fapafapanego tše 3 mengwageng ya 1963 go fihla go 1986.
Amharic: ተመራማሪው ከ1963 እስከ 1986 ባለው ጊዜ ውስጥ ከ3 የተለያዩ ሆስፒታሎች ከ0-14 አመት የሆናቸው ታካሚዎችን የካንሰር ዘገባዎችን አጥንተዋል።

English: They recorded the age, gender, year of diagnosis, type of cancer and which hospital that each patient was from.
Luganda: Baawandiika emyaka, ekikula, omwaka mwe yazuulirwa, ekika kya kookolo n’eddwaliro buli mulwadde lye yalimu.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ṣe àkọsílẹ̀ ọjọ́ orí, ìṣakọṣabo, ọdun àyẹ̀wọ̀ ààrùn, irúfẹ́ ààrùn jẹjẹrẹ àti irú ilé-ìwòsàn tí ọ̀kọ̀ọ̀kan nínú àwọn aláìsàn náà ti wá.
Zulu: Baqopha iminyaka, ubulili, unyaka wokuxilongwa, uhlobo lomdlavuza nokuthi isiguli ngasinye sasiphuma kusiphi isibhedlela.
Hausa: Sun rubuta shekaru da jinsi da shekarar fara gano cutar da nau’in ciwon dajin da kuma daga wane asibiti kowane majiyyaci ya fito.
Northern Sotho: Ba begile mengwaga, bong, mengwaga ya phekolo, mohuta wa kankere le gore ke sepetlele sefe seo molwetši yo mongwe le yo mongwe a tšwago go sona.
Amharic: እድሜ፣ ጾታ፣ የምርመራ አመት፣ የካንሰር አይነት እና እያንዳንዱ ታካሚ ከየትኛው ሆስፒታል እንደመጣ መዝግበዋል።

English: Then, the researcher calculated the frequency of each type of cancer, which is the number of people who suffered with the illness.
Luganda: Oluvannyuma, omunoonyereza yabala omuwendo gwa buli kika kya kookolo, nga guno gwe muwendo gw’abantu abaalina obulwadde obwo.
Yoruba: Nígbà náà, àwọn aṣèwádìí ṣe ìṣirò ìgbà tí irúfẹ́ jẹjẹrẹ kọ̀ọ̀kan máa ń jẹyọ, èyí ni iye èèyàn tí àìsàn yìí ń bájà.
Zulu: Khona-ke, umcwaningi wabala imvamisa yohlobo ngalunye lomdlavuza, okuyinani labantu abaphethwe ukugula.
Hausa: Bayan haka, mai binciken ya ƙididdige yawan adadin kowane nau’in ciwon daji, wanda shi ne adadin mutanen da suka kamu da cutar.
Northern Sotho: Ke moka, monyakišiši o hlakantše boipoeletšo bja mohuta o mongwe le o mongwe wa kankere, e lego palo ya batho bao ba ilego ba hlaselwa ke bolwetši.
Amharic: ከዚያም፣ ተመራማሪው የእያንዳንዱን የካንሰር አይነት ድግግሞሽ ያሰላል፣ ይህም በበሽታው የተጠቁ ሰዎች ቁጥርን ነው።

English: From the 154 childhood cancers that were recorded, they found that the cancers rose from 4% to 15% over the period, and that each type of cancer affected males and females differently.
Luganda: Ku bika bya kookolo w’omu baana 154 ebyawandiikibwa, yakizuula nti kookolo yeeyongera okuva ku bitundu 4% okutuuka ku 15% mu kiseera ekyo, era nti buli kika kya kookolo kyakosa abalenzi n’abawala mu ngeri ez’enjawulo.
Yoruba: Láti 154 jẹjẹrẹ àwọn ọmọdé tí wọ́n ṣe àkọsílẹ̀, wọ́n rí i pé jẹjẹrẹ ti lọ sókè ní ọ̀pọ̀ ìgbà láti 4% sí 15%, àti pé irúfẹ́ jẹjẹrẹ kọ̀ọ̀kan máa ń ran ọkùnrin àti obìnrin lọ́ọ́ọ́tọ̀.
Zulu: Emidlalweni yezingane eyi-154 eyaqoshwa, bathole ukuthi imidlavuza inyuke isuka ku-4% yaya ku-15% ngalesi sikhathi, nokuthi uhlobo ngalunye lomdlavuza luthinta abesilisa nabesifazane ngendlela ehlukile.
Hausa: Daga cikin cututtukan daji na yara guda 154 da aka rubuta, sun gano cewa ciwon daji ya tashi daga kashi 4% zuwa kashi 15% a tsawon lokaci, kuma kowane nau’in ciwon daji yana shafar maza da mata ta hanyoyi daban-daban.
Northern Sotho: Go tšwa go dikankere tša bana ba bosweng tše 154 tšeo di begilwego, ba hweditše gore dikankere di hlatlogile go tloga go 4% go fihla go 15% nakong yeo, le gore mohuta o mongwe le o mongwe wa kankere o amile banna le basadi ka ditsela tše fapanego.
Amharic: ከተመዘገቡት 154 የልጅነት ካንሰሮች በጊዜ ሂደት ካንሰሮች ከ4% ወደ 15% ከፍ ማለቱን፣ እና እያንዳንዱ የካንሰር አይነት ወንድና ሴትን በተለየ መልኩ እንደሚጎዳ አረጋግጠዋል።

English: They also noticed that retinoblastomas were the most common, followed by lymphoma cancers called Hodgkin’s disease and Burkitt’s.
Luganda: Era baakizuula nti retinoblastomas bye bika ebyasinga okulabibwa, ne kuddako kookolo wa lymphoma ayitibwa Hodgkin’s disease ne Burkitt’s.
Yoruba: Wọ́n tún ṣe àkíyèsí pé ààrùn jẹjẹrẹ oju ni ó wọ́pọ̀ jù, lẹ́yìn náa ni ààrùn jẹjẹrẹ omi-ara tí wọ́n pè ní  ààrùn Hodgkin àti ti Burkitt.
Zulu: Baphinde baqaphela ukuthi ama-retinoblastoma yiwona avame kakhulu, alandelwa umdlavuza we-lymphoma obizwa nge-Hodgkin’s disease kanye ne-Burkitt’s.
Hausa: Har ila yau, sun lura cewa kansar ƙwayar ido ta fi zama gama gari, sannan kuma kansar garkuwar jiki da ake kira cutar Hodgkin da kuma Burkitt.
Northern Sotho: Ba lemogile le gore di-retinoblastoma di be di tumile kudu, tša latelwa ke dikankere tša limfoma tše di bitšwago Kankere ya go hlasela mašole a mmele le kankere ya go se hlasele mašole a mmele.
